submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole fires on the token that opens a concrete medium/environment word or a technical, scientific or proper name: 0.6-1.8 on the lowercase medium and register words (wind, water, ice, snow, sand, mud, air, ground, sky, fire, glass, ash, flood, clean, open, health, access), 1.0-3.1 on the capitalised first piece of a split technical or proper word or of a multi-word name - ' Med' in Med|ications, ' Ind' in Ind|oor, ' Inf' in Inf|rared, ' Rad' in Rad|iocarbon, ' Ash' in Ash|okan, ' Wind' in Wind|shield and 'Wind power', ' Water' in 'Clean Water Act', ' White' in 'White House', ' Red' in 'Red Cross', ' Health' in 'Health Organization', ' Internet', ' Windows', ' East' - plus the single-character pieces 'g' (Brid|g|eway, hy|g|ienic) and '-' (X|-Men, G|-d, glow|-worms), and 1.1-2.7 on the short formula openers ' due' (due to), ' up' (up to, up front) and ' come'/'came'/'comes'. It is at zero (<0.3) on everything else - function words; discrete places, objects and substances outside that set (sea, ocean, river, lake, mountain, forest, tree, stone, rock, iron, wood, sun, moon, cloud, table, book, money); the completion pieces of split words (shield, ications, oor, eway, ters, way); the same words written as one token (medications, medical, industry, information, windshield, waterfall, indoor, sandbox) - and a trigger token in the first position of a text reads 0.0 where the identical token mid-text reads 2.0-3.1; the pole is retrospective (its Jacobian and logit lenses are flat, kurtosis 3.2, and zeroing it moves next-token probabilities only weakly, KL < 1e-3).

rival_explanations: The pole is a general word-initial-fragment detector: any first piece of a word that GPT-2 splits into several tokens should fire, so ordinary split words like ' shut' in shutters, ' less' in lesson or ' bott' in bottle should fire as hard as ' Med' or ' Wind', and the register of the word should not matter.

The pole fires only on bound technical stems and single-character pieces that are never standalone words (' Med', ' Ind', ' Inf', ' Rad', ' Ash', ' electr', ' hyd', ' G', 'g', '-'), with the capitalised names as the same phenomenon, so the lowercase medium words (wind, water, ice, snow, clean, open) belong to a different, weaker mechanism and any lowercase-only sentence should stay below the activity line.
